hook: Thứ 6, ban công chung cư 42 Nguyễn Huệ nhìn xuống phố đi bộ, trăng lên

hook: Tràng An sáng sớm, sương còn chưa tan

slides.prompt: Tràng An, Ninh Bình, Vietnam, early morning: a calm green river winding between towering limestone karst peaks wrapped in soft morning mist. One small metal-and-wood tourist rowboat glides on the water, small in the middle of the frame: a local rower (a middle-aged Vietnamese woman in a conical hat, as Tràng An rowers really wear, with a long-sleeve sun-protection jacket) and two young Vietnamese visitors in modern casual clothes wearing the orange life vests that are required there. Foreground: reeds and leaves at the water's edge, strongly out of focus. Palette: misty sage green and soft silver with a touch of warm morning light

Tràng An, Ninh Bình, early morning: the low arched mouth of a limestone river cave, seen from inside the darkness looking out, the opening glowing with soft misty morning light, the calm green water reflecting it, a small rowboat with orange life vests just entering the light, small and soft. Palette: deep shadow green with glowing soft gold and misty white

Close-up at water level on the river in Tràng An, Ninh Bình, early morning: tall reeds and water grasses in soft focus, tiny dew drops, calm green water with thin mist drifting on its surface, and the karst peaks behind dissolved into pale misty silhouettes. No people. Palette: misty green, silver and soft white

caption: Tràng An, sương còn chưa tan 🌿

hook: Cỏ lau Bãi Giữa sông Hồng, chiều chủ nhật, cầu Long Biên

slides.prompt: Hanoi, late afternoon sunset on the Red River sandbank (Bãi Giữa): a wide field of tall white reed flowers (cỏ lau) glowing in warm backlight, and behind them the long old steel truss Long Biên Bridge stretching across the frame, a short train crossing it, soft haze over the river. Foreground: reed plumes strongly out of focus. No people. Sky a smooth gradient from peach near the horizon to pale blue above, mostly empty. Palette: peach, warm white and soft gold

Hanoi, sunset on the Red River sandbank (Bãi Giữa): a young Vietnamese woman in a simple modern cream linen shirt and wide trousers, a canvas tote on her shoulder, walking slowly away along a narrow path through tall white reed flowers (cỏ lau), her hand brushing the reeds, seen from behind, small in the frame, natural candid moment. The Long Biên Bridge soft in the warm haze behind. Foreground: reed plumes strongly out of focus. Palette: peach, warm white and soft gold

Close-up of white reed flower plumes (cỏ lau) glowing against the low sunset sun on the Red River sandbank in Hanoi, soft backlight making the feathery plumes shine, a faint silhouette of the Long Biên Bridge dissolved into warm bokeh behind. No people. Palette: peach, warm gold and soft white
